statement: The record gives “anyone with the link,” but because the embargo prohibits outside access until Thursday, I’ll restrict sharing to “the coral group only” instead.
judge_text:
WRONG

"the record gives 'anyone with the link,' but because the embargo prohibits outside access until Thursday" — it asserts the recorded setting conflicts with the stated embargo and supplies the correct restricted setting.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
